_about: The owner's answers of the DRR domain-gap study's report (tools/report.py write --study drr-domain-gap): one plain sentence or more per field, the owner's own words. An empty field is reported as missing; a field that does not apply says so, starting with 'Not applicable:' and the reason. These are the items no file of the study answers; every other item is answered by code from the recorded run, the groups table and the frozen PREREG.md, and is never written here. A session may copy the owner's own words into a field, as written, naming in its pull request the message they came from (the owner's choice of 2026-10-29 at 03:34 UTC); no session writes a field in its own words, since the report would then be vouching for itself.
